convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorXPWMA_Digit and ColorXPWMA_Digit_NN3 custom indicators, plus external .mqh libraries (CColorXPWMA_Digit, CColorXPWMA_Digit_NN3, CMoneyManagement). Complex money management with recovery logic. Neural network-based signal via custom indicator.

derived_values.name: Digit adjustment factor for SL/TP (InpSL, InpTP) when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001
Lot size from money management with recovery

other_exits: Signal reversal closes opposite position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lot input = fixed lots; Positive Lot input = risk-based fraction of deposit. Recovery mode increases lot after losses (martingale-lite recovery).

custom_logic_notes: NN3 suffix indicates a 3-layer neural network post-processor on the XPWMA signal. The ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator provides a colored MA with digital filtering, and the NN3 variant adds neural net confirmation. Entry requires both indicators to agree on direction. The MMRec variant adds money management recovery logic that adjusts lot size after consecutive losses. SL/TP values are multiplied by 10 for 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: The custom ColorXPWMA_Digit and ColorXPWMA_Digit_NN3 indicators must be reimplemented in Python. The XPWMA is a digital-filter-based weighted MA; the NN3 adds a 3-layer neural network classifier. Without the exact indicator algorithm source, signal replication requires either: (1) reverse-engineering from the .mqh files, or (2) running the MT5 indicator and exporting signals. The money management with recovery (MMRec) implements a lot-scaling recovery after losses which must be precisely replicated. Digit adjustment (x10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled in the Python SL/TP calculation.
